legacy_production.deploy_policy: Do not deploy main here until the coordinated cutover is approved.

migrated_staging.deploy_policy: Deploy an explicit commit and verify build_sha before accepting the environment.

invariants: legacy_production and migrated_staging must never share a deployment target or customer traffic.
A production release must be identified by an immutable commit and release tag.
main is the source branch for the migrated system, not the current legacy production service.
Production data is read-only during migration rehearsal; target writes require a rollback plan.
Backend, frontend, API domain, and database cutover must be approved as one release.
